scenes.title: A Wreath for Samuel
scenes.summary: At the florist's, Andréa orders a wreath for Samuel; Françoise Fabian, Samuel's client, says she won't do Gabor Rajevski's film starting in three weeks, and Andréa loses patience: 'At what age do these whims stop?'

scenes.title: Don't Be So Familiar
scenes.summary: Walking to ASK, Camille tells Hervé how exhausting her first ten days have been. In the lift, her secret father Mathias asks her to avoid familiar address at work, and she protests at being treated like a stranger.

scenes.title: Samuel's Chair
scenes.summary: Mathias takes Samuel's chair and proposes a spreadsheet to divide his clients among the partners. Andréa objects, and their dispute turns to Françoise's withdrawal from Gabor's film and Mathias's twenty-four-hour deadline.

scenes.title: Dinner at Gabriel's
scenes.summary: At Gabriel's flat, Andréa notices a photo of his ex Florence. He explains that they disagreed about having a child; Andréa says she could imagine having a child with him.

scenes.title: The Green Shawl
scenes.summary: Camille tries to persuade Andréa to see unemployed client Rebecca Vialle. Andréa then discovers that Camille sent Françoise a green shawl, a colour she considers unlucky for actresses.

scenes.title: Lunch with Line Renaud
scenes.summary: Gabriel joins Line Renaud for lunch. They remember their friend Samuel; Line meets the sadness with humour and asks about the story of his death in Rio.

scenes.title: Photocopies as punishment
scenes.summary: Camille explains the shawl went in the bin; Andréa sends her off to do lots of photocopies.

scenes.title: A Meeting at the Photocopier
scenes.summary: At the photocopier, Camille meets Andréa's client Hippolyte Rivière. Their familiar chat becomes more formal when she recognises him as an actor; he asks for familiar address again and suggests coffee on the agency terrace.

scenes.title: Something Powerful
scenes.summary: Line wants something powerful and full of life; Gabriel, improvising, offers her Françoise Fabian's part in Gabor Rajevski's elderly Bonnie and Clyde film, and Line likes the sound of it.

scenes.title: The funeral guest lists
scenes.summary: Hervé and Camille juggle the agents' guest lists for the funeral; the producer arrives looking for Andréa.

scenes.title: A Film Never Dies
scenes.summary: Producer Emma challenges Andréa over Françoise's withdrawal and Piccoli's refusal to act without her. Andréa promises to win Françoise back, then struggles to record a convincing voicemail apology.

scenes.title: Line Renaud? What an Idea!
scenes.summary: Gabriel proposes Line Renaud to replace Françoise; Andréa finds the idea absurd and calls it another film; he calls her a snob.

scenes.title: Gabriel has doubts
scenes.summary: Gabriel has doubts; Hervé offers carrot juice and tells him to call Line back; Gabriel tells Line he got carried away, the script is very violent, but Line is unbothered and leaves for the Lido. A text calls the partners to an emergency meeting with Hélène Kerr.

scenes.title: Hélène Wants to Sell
scenes.summary: At a hotel, Hélène explains that Samuel left no will and that she wants to sell the shares she has inherited. Andréa proposes that the four partners buy them, leading to an argument about money.

scenes.title: A sleepless night online
scenes.summary: Unable to sleep, Andréa checks her bank site, then a dating site; a chat goes badly.

scenes.title: You're All My Family
scenes.summary: At a café, Andréa describes her night of loan calculations. Arlette offers her money to help the agency, saying the agents and actors are her family; her dog Jean Gabin interrupts the conversation.

scenes.title: Line and Françoise, an Old Story
scenes.summary: At the café, Arlette explains to Andréa why Gabriel's casting suggestion is oddly amusing. Françoise introduced her former partner Samuel to Line decades earlier, and the actresses' different careers deepened their rivalry.

scenes.title: Sofia's favour
scenes.summary: Camille asks Sofia to send photos to a casting director; Gabriel explains why the brunette is among the blondes.

scenes.title: A Chance Meeting
scenes.summary: In a park, Andréa pretends to meet Françoise by chance and apologises. She says Gabor is considering Line Renaud for the film, using the actresses' rivalry to draw Françoise back to the part.

scenes.title: I did a Mathias
scenes.summary: Andréa boasts she turned Françoise by lying about Line, the power of rivalry; the film is saved.

scenes.title: Two Actresses for One Part
scenes.summary: Line arrives at ASK, delighted after two hours with Gabor and expecting to start filming in three weeks. Andréa and Gabriel now have two actresses expecting the same part, and their disagreement becomes personal.

scenes.title: I Hate Actresses
scenes.summary: Mathias proposes a buyout that would leave Hélène holding seventeen percent of ASK until the partners could buy the rest. She turns to Samuel's affairs with actresses, explains her resentment, and says she has other offers.

scenes.title: Sofia leaves
scenes.summary: Sofia says goodnight.

scenes.title: An Invisible Line
scenes.summary: Hippolyte collects a script from Camille at ASK. Later, at a bar, he explains an imaginary camera axis between them; their conversation about film love scenes becomes a flirtation and they kiss.

scenes.title: A scooter to the funeral
scenes.summary: The next morning Hippolyte offers Camille a ride to the funeral on his scooter.

scenes.title: Goodbye, Samuel
scenes.summary: After Samuel's burial, Gabriel welcomes guests to the agency's tribute and introduces Françoise. Françoise and Line take turns remembering Samuel, and their rivalry colours the tribute before they sing together.

scenes.title: What If We Took Both?
scenes.summary: Andréa suggests casting both actresses as a couple of elderly robbers. Gabriel argues for the pairing's appeal, while Emma clarifies the idea and points out the cost of two performers' fees. Andréa offers a lower price.

scenes.title: The Whole Family's Here
scenes.summary: Hippolyte introduces Camille to his mother Catherine. Catherine mentions her husband and calls Mathias over, revealing to Camille that Hippolyte is her half-brother. Camille addresses Mathias formally in front of the family.

scenes.title: Last Night
scenes.summary: In a back room, Camille asks Hippolyte what happened at his flat the night before. He recounts their kiss and carrying her to bed; she is relieved to learn that she then fell asleep almost immediately.

scenes.title: Sorry About Yesterday
scenes.summary: Andréa and Gabriel apologise after their argument and acknowledge the casting idea. Gabriel promises to support her wish for a child and go with her to Holland; Andréa admits how much his friendship means to her.

scenes.title: I'm Your Family Too
scenes.summary: Mathias confronts Camille about Hippolyte. She accuses him of lying and neglecting them, then insists she is his family too. Noémie declines her request for a light; Arlette supplies one and comforts her with an image of troubles going up in smoke.
